description: This is a Java interface defining methods for retrieving static content files from a Content Management System (CMS) related to a merchant store.

classes.name: FileGet
classes.description: A Java interface for retrieving static content files from the CMS, providing methods to get a file, get file names, and get multiple files based on merchant store code and content type.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific file from the CMS given a merchant store code, content type, and content name.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of file names from the CMS for a given merchant store code and content type.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of content files from the CMS for a given merchant store code and content type.
